steps.content: With all your might, the two of you finally manage to pull No. 15 and Dullahan out of the Mania vortex, retreating to a corner barely shielded from the corruption.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: I thought you wanted a property tour! You tricked me!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I'd told you this place was falling apart, you probably wouldn't have taken me back here, right? I guess I should thank your property hotline for being accessible 24/7.

With no wedding festivities to crash, Luminita had left the castle shortly after you woke up. But her professional dedication got the better of her, and one phone call was all it took to lure her back. Now she leans against the wall, still shaken and breathing heavily.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: That thing's power is way too overwhelming—getting close is basically suicide! And I can't believe such a fine property is about to get destroyed too!
While the castle is hardly the priority right now, you don't have the energy to point out her misplaced concerns.

options: We need to distract Graves first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Graves's attention is completely fixated on that damn ring. Using the shackles now would only agitate her more. We need to find a way to get her attention before there's any chance of talking to her.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: But how do we do it? She looks completely out of touch with reality. Unless...

Luminita hugs herself in disbelief and steals a glance in your direction before summoning her resolve. With a determined expression, she sheds her coat, preparing to dash forward and unleash a flurry of dance moves.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if you were a breakdancing champ, it wouldn't help. I was talking about using the journal from the study.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not what I mean... Graves doesn't want anyone to learn about her childhood.
The secrets of a little monster... things she wants to keep buried forever...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Luminita, I'm leaving No. 15 and Dullahan in your hands. I'll be right back.
